question:
I heard before that Otsuka-sensei's character designs are almost always approved on the first try. Is that still true for Arcs 6 and 7?

I've been curious about the kind of back-and-forth the two of you have when so many attractive and distinctive characters are being introduced one after another at such a fast pace in Arc 7. Is it still true that Otsuka-sensei's character designs are almost always approved on the first try?
answer:
The part about Arcs 6 and 7 getting approved on the first try hasn't changed.

When I write a story, I'm the type who doesn't picture the characters visually in my head; instead, they come out to me in words. Otsuka-sensei creates the new characters with a high degree of accuracy based on the settings I give him, and when I see the illustrations, there's this moment where I think, “Ah, so this is what this character looks like,” and everything clicks into place for me.

I've been working with Otsuka-sensei for nine years now, and his accuracy has gotten even higher, so Arcs 6 and 7 still get approved on the first try. There may be corrections or additions to small details and accessories, but when it comes to important things like the characters' appearance, there are often no changes at all.

Otsuka-sensei is amazing!!!
